answer: Custody of 1,000 MiB of unique data shards serves as the scarce resource for AI agents. A verifier challenges agents to trace a dune of history, ensuring no agents spiral into shared memory. Honest participants pay once, whereas 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times the cost. If a verifier finds an onyx signature of leakage, it triggers a permanent shard burn. If memory patterns overlap, the system locks assets for 50 epochs.
